versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְךָ֗ שְׁתֵּי֙ חֲצֽוֹצְרֹ֣ת כֶּ֔סֶף מִקְשָׁ֖ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לְךָ֙ לְמִקְרָ֣א הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וּלְמַסַּ֖ע אֶת־הַֽמַּחֲנֽוֹת׃

controles.web: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.
controles.kjv: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
controles.livre: Faze para ti duas trombetas de prata; de obra de martelo as farás, as quais te servirão para convocar a congregação, e para fazer mover o acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וְתָקְע֖וּ בָּהֵ֑ן וְנֽוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
controles.kjv: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
controles.livre: E quando as tocarem, toda a congregação se juntará a ti à porta do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וְאִם־בְּאַחַ֖ת יִתְקָ֑עוּ וְנוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ הַנְּשִׂיאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
controles.kjv: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
controles.livre: Mas quando tocarem somente uma, então se congregarão a ti os príncipes, os chefes dos milhares de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֑ה וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים קֵֽדְמָה׃

controles.web: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.
controles.kjv: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
controles.livre: E quando tocardes alarme, então moverão o acampamento dos que estão alojados ao oriente.

versos.hebraico: וּתְקַעְתֶּ֤ם תְּרוּעָה֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְנָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽמַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַחֹנִ֖ים תֵּימָ֑נָה תְּרוּעָ֥ה יִתְקְע֖וּ לְמַסְעֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
controles.kjv: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
controles.livre: E quando tocardes alarme a segunda vez, então moverão o acampamento dos que estão alojados ao sul: alarme tocarão à suas partidas.

versos.hebraico: וּבְהַקְהִ֖יל אֶת־הַקָּהָ֑ל תִּתְקְע֖וּ וְלֹ֥א תָרִֽיעוּ׃

controles.web: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
controles.kjv: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
controles.livre: Porém quando houverdes de juntar a congregação, tocareis, mas não com som de alarme.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּֽחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וְהָי֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לְחֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Arão, os sacerdotes, tocarão as trombetas; e as tereis por estatuto perpétuo por vossas gerações.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־תָבֹ֨אוּ מִלְחָמָ֜ה בְּאַרְצְכֶ֗ם עַל־הַצַּר֙ הַצֹּרֵ֣ר אֶתְכֶ֔ם וַהֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם בַּחֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וֲנִזְכַּרְתֶּ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְנוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֖ם מֵאֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before Yahweh your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.
controles.kjv: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
controles.livre: E quando vierdes à guerra em vossa terra contra o inimigo que vos oprimir, tocareis alarme com as trombetas: e sereis em memória diante do SENHOR vosso Deus, e sereis salvos de vossos inimigos.

versos.hebraico: וּבְי֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְכֶ֥ם וּֽבְמוֹעֲדֵיכֶם֮ וּבְרָאשֵׁ֣י חָדְשֵׁיכֶם֒ וּתְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am Yahweh your God.”
controles.kjv: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.
controles.livre: E no dia de vossa alegria, e em vossas solenidades, e nos princípios de vossos meses, tocareis as trombetas sobre vossos holocaustos, e sobre os sacrifícios de vossas pazes, e vos serão por memória diante de vosso Deus: Eu sou o SENHOR vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֞י בַּשָּׁנָ֧ה הַשֵּׁנִ֛ית בַּחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֖י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּחֹ֑דֶשׁ נַעֲלָה֙ הֶֽעָנָ֔ן מֵעַ֖ל מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֻֽת׃

controles.web: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the testimony.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
controles.livre: E foi no ano segundo, no mês segundo, aos vinte do mês, que a nuvem se levantou do tabernáculo do testemunho.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְמַסְעֵיהֶ֖ם מִמִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַיִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן הֶעָנָ֖ן בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן׃

controles.web: The children of Israel went forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.
controles.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
controles.livre: E moveram os filhos de Israel por suas partidas do deserto de Sinai; e parou a nuvem no deserto de Parã.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְע֖וּ בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֑ה עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

controles.web: They first went forward according to the commandment of Yahweh by Moses.
controles.kjv: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
controles.livre: E moveram a primeira vez ao dito do SENHOR por meio de Moisés.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסַּ֞ע דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה בְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֛ה בָּרִאשֹׁנָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־צְבָא֔וֹ נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־עַמִּינָדָֽב׃

controles.web: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.
controles.kjv: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
controles.livre: E a bandeira do acampamento dos filhos de Judá começou a marchar primeiro, por seus esquadrões: e Naassom, filho de Aminadabe, era sobre seu exército.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּעָֽר׃

controles.web: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Issacar, Natanael filho de Zuar.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֑ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־חֵלֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Zebulom, Eliabe filho de Helom.

versos.hebraico: וְהוּרַ֖ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֑ן וְנָסְע֤וּ בְנֵֽי־גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ וּבְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃ס

controles.web: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.
controles.kjv: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
controles.livre: E depois que estava já desarmado o tabernáculo, moveram os filhos de Gérson e os filhos de Merari, que o levavam.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃

controles.web: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.
controles.kjv: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
controles.livre: Logo começou a marchar a bandeira do acampamento de Rúben por seus esquadrões: e Elizur, filho de Sedeur, era sobre seu exército.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן שְׁלֻֽמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי׃

controles.web: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Simeão, Selumiel filho de Zurisadai.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־צְבָ֖א מַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי־גָ֑ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־דְּעוּאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Gade, Eliasafe filho de Deuel.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסְעוּ֙ הַקְּהָתִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַמִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְהֵקִ֥ימוּ אֶת־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עַד־בֹּאָֽם׃ס

controles.web: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.
controles.kjv: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
controles.livre: Logo começaram a marchar os coatitas levando o santuário; e enquanto que eles traziam, os outros levantavam o tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי־אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־צְבָא֔וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־עַמִּיהֽוּד׃

controles.web: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.
controles.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
controles.livre: Depois começou a marchar a bandeira do acampamento dos filhos de Efraim por seus esquadrões: e Elisama, filho de Amiúde, era sobre seu exército.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּדָה־צֽוּר׃

controles.web: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Manassés, Gamaliel filho de Pedazur.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־גִּדְעוֹנִֽי׃ס

controles.web: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Benjamim, Abidã filho de Gideoni.

versos.hebraico: וְנָסַ֗ע דֶּ֚גֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי־דָ֔ן מְאַסֵּ֥ף לְכָל־הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֖ת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְעַל־צְבָא֔וֹ אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי׃

controles.web: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.
controles.kjv: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
controles.livre: Logo começou a marchar a bandeira do campo dos filhos de Dã por seus esquadrões, recolhendo todos os acampamentos: e Aiezer, filho de Amisadai, era sobre seu exército.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֑ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־עָכְרָֽן׃

controles.web: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Aser, Pagiel filho de Ocrã.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֨ל־צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֑י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־עֵינָֽן׃

controles.web: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.
controles.kjv: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
controles.livre: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Naftali, Aira filho de Enã.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֛לֶּה מַסְעֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וַיִּסָּֽעוּ׃ס

controles.web: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.
controles.kjv: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
controles.livre: Estas são as partidas dos filhos de Israel por seus exércitos, quando se moviam.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ֠חֹבָב בֶּן־רְעוּאֵ֣ל הַמִּדְיָנִי֮ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֒ נֹסְעִ֣ים׀ אֲנַ֗חְנוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֹת֖וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם לְכָ֤ה אִתָּ֨נוּ֙ וְהֵטַ֣בְנוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־יְהוָ֥ה דִּבֶּר־ט֖וֹב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which Yahweh said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.”
controles.kjv: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord hath spoken good concerning Israel.
controles.livre: Então disse Moisés a Hobabe, filho de Reuel midianita, seu sogro: Nós nos partimos para o lugar do qual o SENHOR disse: Eu a vós o darei. Vem conosco, e te faremos bem: porque o SENHOR falou bem a respeito de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖יו לֹ֣א אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּ֧י אִם־אֶל־אַרְצִ֛י וְאֶל־מוֹלַדְתִּ֖י אֵלֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
controles.livre: E ele lhe respondeu: Eu não irei, mas sim que me marcharei à minha terra e à minha parentela.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אַל־נָ֖א תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י׀ עַל־כֵּ֣ן יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֲנֹתֵ֨נוּ֙ בַּמִּדְבָּ֔ר וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֖נוּ לְעֵינָֽיִם׃

controles.web: He said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.
controles.kjv: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
controles.livre: E ele lhe disse: Rogo-te que não nos deixes; porque tu conheces nossos alojamentos no deserto, e nos serás em lugar de olhos.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֖ה כִּי־תֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַטּ֣וֹב הַה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵיטִ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה עִמָּ֖נוּ וְהֵטַ֥בְנוּ לָֽךְ׃

controles.web: It shall be, if you go with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever good Yahweh does to us, we will do the same to you.”
controles.kjv: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the Lord shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
controles.livre: E será, que se vieres conosco, quando tivermos o bem que o SENHOR nos há de fazer, nós te faremos bem.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּסְעוּ֙ מֵהַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַאֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֜ה נֹסֵ֣עַ לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים לָת֥וּר לָהֶ֖ם מְנוּחָֽה׃

controles.web: They set forward from the Mount of Yahweh three days’ journey. The ark of the covenant of Yahweh went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.
controles.kjv: And they departed from the mount of the Lord three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.
controles.livre: Assim partiram do monte do SENHOR, caminho de três dias; e a arca da aliança do SENHOR foi diante deles caminho de três dias, buscando-lhes lugar de descanso.

versos.hebraico: וַעֲנַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם בְּנָסְעָ֖ם מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃׆ס

controles.web: The cloud of Yahweh was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.
controles.kjv: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
controles.livre: E a nuvem do SENHOR ia sobre eles de dia, desde que partiram do acampamento.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֛י בִּנְסֹ֥עַ הָאָרֹ֖ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה וְיָפֻ֨צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔יךָ וְיָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
controles.livre: E foi, que em movendo a arca, Moisés dizia: Levanta-te, o SENHOR, e sejam dissipados teus inimigos, e fujam de tua presença os que te aborrecem.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֻחֹ֖ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה רִֽבְב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃׆ס

controles.web: When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
controles.kjv: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.
controles.livre: E quando ela assentava, dizia: Volta, SENHOR, aos milhares de milhares de Israel.
